name: Fang of Bhag'thera
summary: Bhag'thera's fang is proof of a hunter's skill in Stranglethorn Vale. Sir S. J. Erlgadin asks for it as the final measure of Panther Mastery.

sections.title: A Hunter's Proof
sections.body: Erlgadin sends you after Bhag'thera, an elusive panther prowling the jungle near Nesingwary's Expedition. His party has failed to catch the great beast, and your hunt will decide whether you have earned Erlgadin's respect. Bring him the fang, and he will hail you as a mighty hunter.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition asks you to bring him Bhag'thera's fang.
Bhag'thera is an elusive panther prowling the jungle in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Erlgadin want the fang?
faq.answer: The fang proves that you have hunted Bhag'thera and earned Erlgadin's respect as a panther hunter.
Bhag'thera prowls the jungle in Stranglethorn Vale, near Nesingwary's Expedition.

angles.text: As a hunter, Bhag'thera's fang marks the final test in Sir S. J. Erlgadin's Panther Mastery trial.
